caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional rectangular box with a slightly overhanging flat lid, positioned at an angle so that two sides and the top are visible. The box features elaborate, raised decorative carvings on its visible surfaces. Both sides are adorned with intricate designs, borders, and what appear to be images of human figures and foliage within arched panels. Below the central motif on each side, there is a horizontal band containing raised text and numbers; on the left side, "S.B." is visible within an ornate rounded medallion, while the right side shows the number "77" within an oval frame, flanked by more text. The material texture appears rough and stone-like, rendered in a grayscale palette typical of black-and-white drawings or photographs. The composition centers the box on a blank, matte background with a light border surrounding the image.
title: Pa. German Jamb Stove
